source_policy: Fresh Geofabrik/OpenStreetMap download; Wikipedia/Wikimedia keyless public endpoints; license-checked Wikimedia image candidates; no API keys or tokens; generated assets are stored locally for offline runtime

origin.crs: WGS84 input; local equirectangular meters; X=east, Z=north, Y=height

wikimedia_candidates.note: Candidate photos are not auto-applied without verified building identity and facade mapping

building_matching: Wikipedia titles are automatically compared to locally saved OSM building names; exact matches are candidates only, not visual identity proof.
